name: Embermoor
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are towering mountain ranges, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Nothing about temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls biomass controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
